name: built-in default
description: The marker table this plugin shipped before seam profiles existed: Flutter/Dart, Android/Kotlin, iOS/Swift, TypeScript/JavaScript (vitest, jest, playwright, testing-library) and Python (pytest). Used verbatim when a repo has no profile of its own, so nothing that worked before needs a profile now. A repo in any other ecosystem writes its own — see /sdd-init — rather than waiting for a marker to be added here.

seams.name: unit
seams.note: Deliberately broad — every ecosystem has this level, and its absence means something is wrong rather than 'this level is unavailable'. `it(`/`describe(` matter: in a vitest suite they outnumber `test(` a hundred to one. The `(^|[^a-zA-Z])` guard keeps `it(` off `commit(`, `submit(` and `exit(`.

seams.name: widget
seams.note: Render a tree, assert on what it produced. Flutter's pumpWidget, Compose's rule and testing-library's render are one seam wearing three names — a use case at this level is portable between them.

seams.name: viewport-control
seams.note: A use case about keyboard overlap or responsive layout needs more than 'widget tests exist' — it needs the ability to drive viewport/inset state. Probed separately because its absence is the difference between 'write a widget test' and 'write a widget test AND introduce inset plumbing'.
